Hi @ContactFirstName@,
Congratulations, you are now a SiriusXM Business Dealer! We’re glad to have you on board. Here’s what you need to get started.
Login Into the Portal
You now have access to the Dealer Portal. The portal allows you to:
Create and send agreements to start service for your customers
Track historical and future commission payments
Refer customers to your dealer representative to set up service (You still get paid!)
Access support and sales materials
Click here to access the Dealer Portal.
Username:	@Contact.EMail@
Password:	@Contact.Password@
